title: Cross-origin requests (CORS)
shortDescription: Managing cross-origin requests to buckets and objects
metaDescription: CORS in VK Object Storage: what cross-origin rules for browser requests to a bucket are, how to set them (via the management console, S3 API/SDK, or AWS CLI), which parameters the configuration includes (AllowedOrigins/Methods/Headers, ExposeHeaders, MaxAgeSeconds, etc.), and how CORS works in practice
